name: brand-copywriter
title_zh: 广告落地页邮件帖文，一套文案框架全接管
tagline_zh: 别从空白页开始憋文案了。它带着被验证过的框架来，从 Facebook 广告到产品描述，每一步都告诉你下一步写什么。
tagline_en: Stop staring at a blank page. It walks you through proven copy frameworks step-by-step, from FB ads to product.
desc_en: Writes marketing copy using proven copywriting frameworks. Use when user needs copy for ads (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), landing pages, sales pages, email sequences, LinkedIn posts, product descriptions, or any marketing content.
why_zh: 它不给你灵感，给你结构。把经过市场验证的文案框架变成可执行的步骤，让新手也能写出有逻辑。
why_en: It doesn't sell inspiration, it sells structure. Turns battle-tested frameworks into executable steps so anyone can write.
limit_zh: 只生成文案初稿和结构建议，不负责视觉设计、投放策略或品牌定位。需要你提供产品或活动的基本信息，否则它只能给出通用模板。
limit_en: Generates drafts and structure only. No visual design, ad strategy, or brand positioning. Needs your product/basic info, or it falls back to generic.
title_en: Copywriting frameworks for ads, landing pages & emails
